pages.title: Noren Curtains
pages.text: Noren come in four patterns — plain, striped, wavy and long — each in all 16 colors.

pages.title: Stone Lantern
pages.text: A two-block stone garden lantern, solid all through, giving no light of its own.

pages.title: Wrought Iron Railings
pages.text: Blackened ironwork that lends a room some weight.

pages.title: Paper Goods
pages.text: Two paper-made building blocks, each in a solid and a thin pane form. They let light through rather than blocking it, so a room sealed with them stays bright, and they burn as fuel too.

pages.title: Plank Walls
pages.text: Plank walls come in every wood type, and are cheap to make.

pages.title: Tiles
pages.text: Tiles come in seven colors: cyan, orange, yellow, brown, blue, black and gray. Every color has stairs, slabs and wall panels.

pages.title: Ice Bricks
pages.text: Thematic bricks made from packed ice, with stairs, slabs and vertical slabs. Suitable for snowy environments.

pages.title: Myouren Temple Blocks
pages.text: Building blocks for structures: stairs, slabs and vertical slabs, a donation box in the temple's style, a locust plaque, and more.
